description: This Java class 'WebDaemon' provides functionality to start the OpenMRS server within a web application context. It encapsulates logic to initiate daemon tasks asynchronously, handling specific exceptions related to database updates and input requirements.

classes.name: WebDaemon
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to start OpenMRS in a web environment, ensuring proper exception handling and asynchronous execution.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Starts the OpenMRS server asynchronously within a web context using a new daemon thread, with handling for specific startup-related exceptions.
